description: This file defines the Map class for the Leaflet library, including methods for map manipulation, event handling, and map state management. It imports various modules for utilities, geometry, and DOM interactions.

classes.name: Map
classes.description: Main class for creating and manipulating a map instance, including options for view, zoom, layers, event handling, and map state management.

methods.name: setView
methods.description: Sets the map view to a specified center and zoom level, with optional animation.

methods.name: setZoom
methods.description: Sets the zoom level of the map.

methods.name: zoomIn
methods.description: Increases the zoom level by a specified delta.

methods.name: zoomOut
methods.description: Decreases the zoom level by a specified delta.

methods.name: flyTo
methods.description: Performs a smooth pan-zoom animation to a specified center and zoom.

methods.name: fitBounds
methods.description: Adjusts the map view to fit given geographical bounds.

methods.name: getCenter
methods.description: Returns the current geographical center of the map.

methods.name: getBounds
methods.description: Returns the geographical bounds currently visible.

methods.name: invalidateSize
methods.description: Checks if the map container size changed and updates the map accordingly.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Destroys the map instance and clears all event listeners and layers.
